quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap neutralizing CHF 7.9B in MBCC acquisition goodwill and intangibles (tangible ROIC ~59.6%). Net debt rapidly reduced post-MBCC to CHF 3.0B (repayable in 2.5 years) with 9.6x interest coverage and >110% FCF conversion. Forward growth of 7.0% supported by infrastructure/refurbishment secular demand (3.5%), net pricing (0.5%), MBCC cost/revenue synergies (1.5%), and bolt-on acquisitions (1.5%). At 20.62x peak Owner EPS, shares trade Below PAR (-16.3% discount vs PAR value of CHF 221.23), offering an attractive 11.8% 5Y expected IRR.
